Initial release of prior-auth-letter-drafter:

- Generates professional prior authorization request letters for insurance companies with standardized formatting and clinical justification.
- Supports medical codes (ICD-10, CPT/HCPCS) and customizable templates for different insurance carriers.
- Command-line usage with audit-ready commands and robust input parameter validation.
- Produces structured DOCX output including required provider, patient, and service details.
- Includes security and risk assessment guidelines, with fallback procedures for missing inputs or execution errors.
